component.name: FRLG Studio
component.summary: Wireless trade, storage and editing for Pokémon FireRed and LeafGreen

description.p: FRLG Studio connects to a Nintendo Switch running Pokémon FireRed or LeafGreen over local wireless. It provides a desktop trade screen, Bill's PC storage, a .pk3 editor and a Wonder Card builder.
Live trading needs a supported wireless adapter and administrator access for the radio. A recorded-capture rehearsal mode works without a Switch.
Adds the three-bus sound system, Bill's PC multi-select, box wallpapers, encounter-aware level-up moves and legalize, summary ball/item badges, and the console-timed trade stage.
First portable release: bundled Python, Qt, .NET and PKHeX, with user data stored in the standard XDG data and config directories.
